svg.metadata: LCD segments of Elektronika IM-02 "Nu, pogodi!". Vector traced from a scan of the real screen for MAME (nupogodi.svg, artwork by Igor and hap, display improvements by algestam). No licence stated by the authors. The screen artwork belongs to its original creators; characters are from the Soyuzmultfilm cartoon. Coordinates baked from the original file, ids follow the MAME segment numbering.
